label: Bible Study
prompt: So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me _____, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.
verse: So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.
note: God's word is like rain and snow — it always comes back having done its job.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And all nations shall call you _____: for ye shall be a delightsome land, saith the LORD of hosts.
verse: And all nations shall call you blessed: for ye shall be a delightsome land, saith the LORD of hosts.
note: Malachi's promise after the tithe challenge: all nations shall call you blessed — a delightsome land.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a _____ mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.
verse: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.
note: Pentecost began with a sound from heaven like a rushing mighty wind, filling the whole house.

label: Deep Water
prompt: No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath _____ him.
verse: No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.
note: The prologue's finale: no one has seen God, but the Son from the Father's bosom has made him known.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For God is not the author of _____, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.
verse: For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.
note: God is not 'the author of confusion' — Paul's case for orderly worship in a very noisy Corinth.
